other_mijikenda: Duruma: same name 'Mbangula mavi' (Pakia App. VI)

teaser.en: One shrub, two household jobs: its soft leaves serve as toilet paper, and also polish beads.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kimoja, kazi mbili za nyumbani: majani yake laini hutumika kama karatasi ya chooni, na pia kung'arisha shanga.

summary.en: This yellow-flowered Abutilon has two Digo names, both for its uses: mbangula mavi, 'faeces cleaner', and mtsusa tsalu, 'bead cleaner'. Both depend on its soft, hairy leaves.
summary.sw: Abutilon hii yenye maua ya manjano ina majina mawili ya Kidigo, yote yakitokana na matumizi yake: mbangula mavi, 'kisafisha mavi', na mtsusa tsalu, 'kisafisha shanga'. Yote mawili yanategemea majani yake laini yenye manyoya.

about.en: This *Abutilon* is a soft-wooded shrub of the mallow family. Its heart-shaped, toothed leaves are covered in fine soft hairs. It has yellow, hibiscus-like flowers and a fruit made of a ring of hairy segments that split apart when dry. It looks very like its relative *Abutilon mauritianum*, which shares the name *mbangula mavi*. Digo people identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Abutilon* hii ni kichaka chenye mbao laini cha familia ya Malvaceae. Majani yake yenye umbo la moyo na meno kingoni yamefunikwa kwa vinywele vyembamba laini. Ina maua ya manjano yanayofanana na ya hibiscus, na tunda lililoundwa kwa duara la vipande vyenye manyoya vinavyoachana vikikauka. Inafanana sana na ndugu yake *Abutilon mauritianum*, unaoshiriki jina *mbangula mavi*. Wadigo huitambua kwa majani yake.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland, thicket and forest margins, and on old farmland.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka vya pwani, vichaka vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu, na kwenye mashamba ya zamani.

uses.en: Pakia records two household uses, each preserved in a name. The leaves are used as toilet paper, and they are used to clean beads (*tsalu*), the beadwork that decorates the edges of cloth.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti matumizi mawili ya nyumbani, kila moja likihifadhiwa katika jina. Majani hutumika kama karatasi ya chooni, na pia hutumika kusafisha shanga (*tsalu*), zile shanga zinazopamba kingo za nguo.

culture.en: Pakia gives *mbangula mavi* and *mtsusa tsalu* as examples of Digo names based on domestic use, and says that the plants are 'used as their names indicate'.
culture.sw: Pakia anatoa *mbangula mavi* na *mtsusa tsalu* kama mifano ya majina ya Kidigo yanayotokana na matumizi ya nyumbani, na anasema kwamba mimea hii 'hutumika kama majina yake yanavyoonyesha'.

names.en: Digo: *mbangula mavi*, 'clear human waste' (from *bangula*, to clean oneself, and *mavi*, waste), shared with Duruma. Also *mtsusa tsalu*, 'cleaning beads'. Mgombato gives *tsusa* as 'to clean something' and *tsalu* as 'beads decorating the edge of a piece of cloth'. Both names are shared with other plants. *Mbangula mavi* is also *Abutilon mauritianum*. *Mtsusa tsalu* is also *Triumfetta rhomboidea* and *Waltheria indica*, small herbs whose leaves are presumably used the same way. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbangula mavi*, 'kusafisha uchafu wa binadamu' (kutoka *bangula*, kujisafisha, na *mavi*, kinyesi), linaloshirikiwa na Kiduruma. Pia *mtsusa tsalu*, 'kusafisha shanga'. Mgombato inatoa *tsusa* kama 'kusafisha kitu' na *tsalu* kama 'shanga zinazopamba ukingo wa kipande cha nguo'. Majina yote mawili yanashirikiwa na mimea mingine. *Mbangula mavi* pia ni *Abutilon mauritianum*. *Mtsusa tsalu* pia ni *Triumfetta rhomboidea* na *Waltheria indica*, mimea midogo ambayo huenda majani yake hutumika kwa njia hiyohiyo. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
